editorial.blurb: Manchamanteles is a family-friendly Mexican restaurant celebrated for its sophisticated mole preparations and vibrant takes on classic dishes like cochinita pibil and creative specials.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask about their mole options—reviewers consistently highlight the diverse mole selections, including the floral rose-petal mole and traditional mole negro, and don't miss the complimentary spicy trail mix served at arrival.
